criteria: Must include config.steps with a discrete classification method like {'type': 'quantiles', 'count': 5} or {'type': 'jenks', 'count': 5} (NOT continuous)
paint.size must be an array [min, max] for size scaling across the 5 discrete classes
paint.color should be a single color value (not an array, since only size varies by class)
Should include reasonable point defaults (opacity, strokeColor, strokeWidth as appropriate for points)
